target.tool: Customer-verified business interface; open-document restrictions apply

key.note: Preserve source identifiers in an audit ledger; map regenerated internal IDs and target numbering. Never assume internal IDs survive migration.

structures.preprocessing: Unscoped candidate rows. Approve the full-key population at cutover; use customer-cohort-project.json. Stock is a frozen, reconciled inventory population, including batch and special stock. MARD quantities alone do not establish complete inventory. Physical inventory, valuation, units and currency conversion need business sign-off. Historical goods movements are reference data. Open purchasing scope requires item status, receipts, invoices, deletion, returns and remaining quantities; it is not inferred from the header alone. Select EKKO document category K and approved contract types; exclude purchase orders and scheduling agreements. Verify validity, value versus quantity contract, remaining target obligation and releases against the contract. Link account assignments and time-dependent conditions; release history is evidence, not a second purchase-order load. Supplier, CO/PS and account mappings require cross-domain approval.
